Kara: quick sync note  we're still losing billing fidelity when we compact traces during bursts. want a short operational playbook: deterministic attribution + minimal runtime SDK contract.
Owen: +1. let's capture the minimum surface: admin policy API, runtime shed modes, sdk advisory API, compaction_audit shape, and incident runbook. keep it <1 page.
Felix: suggested runtime shed modes: PASS_THROUGH (no changes), TRIM_ATTRS (drop non-essential span attrs), SKELETON (write id+minimal attrs, async-enrich), DROP (discard non-critical).
Ivy: we need deterministic cohort ids so downstream billing can join dropped events with later rehydrates. propose cohort_id = sha256(tenant|route|minute_bucket|policy_version).
Kara: compaction_audit event must be emitted for every non-pass_through action. fields: cohort_id, tenant, route, mode, tokens_saved, sample_label, orig_ids? (when available) and timestamp.
Owen: example compact record: 
```json
{"cohort_id":"sha256:...","tenant":"acct-77","route":"/v1/gen","mode":"SKELETON","tokens_saved":4821,"sample_label":"preemptive_v2","orig_ids":["id1","id2"]}
```
Felix: billing uses sample_label to map cost policy. if orig_ids absent we attribute to "compaction_reserve" until rehydration updates it. good.
Ivy: SDK advisory API idea: telemetry.advisory({level:'ok'|'notice'|'shed',actions:['trim_attrs','drop_spans'],ttl_s:45}). SDKs implement best-effort trimming before serialization. advisory only; server decides final fate.
Kara: admin policy payload (POST /ops/telemetry/policy): 
```json
{"scope":"service:ingest-proxy","rolling_tokens":2000000,"soft_pct":0.6,"hard_pct":0.92,"priority_cutoffs": [120,240,500],"enrich_ttl_s":10800}
```
Owen: runtime predicate engine should evaluate tiny boolean rules: e.g. `if cpu_pct>80 && queue_ms>200 -> mode=SKELETON for priority>=200`. keep expressions simple and auditable.
Felix: rehydration path: when enrichment arrives after compaction, write a rehydrate_patch referencing cohort_id and orig_ids if resolved. emit rehydrate_delta with tokens_consumed and attribution_map. billing reconciles compaction_reserve.
Ivy: monitoring hooks: metric telemetry.compaction.count, telemetry.compaction.tokens_saved, and a histogram of compaction_latency_ms. also expose per-tenant compaction_rate.
Kara: incident runbook short: 
- T0: push /ops policy bump (increase soft_pct->hard_pct)
- T1: enable SKELETON for non-critical routes via predicate toggle
- T2: if still high, enable DROP for experimental routes and notify customers
- Post: 72h cohort analysis on compaction_audit to quantify missed signals and billing delta

Owen: action items: I'll prototype the predicate engine + admin API mock. Felix will draft compaction_audit + rehydrate_delta schemas. Ivy will add instrumentation to SDK repo prototype for advisory handling. Kara will write the 1-page playbook and schedule gate review.
telemetry-bot: deploy note: telemetry-proxy v4.0 canary started :rocket:
Kara: thanks all 44D will share the doc in #eng-docs before EOD.
